rows.grounds: instrumental of ekākṣarā, the one-syllable mantra
nominative singular masculine participle of sidh
middle voice present third singular of jan
ablative singular of kṣaṇa used adverbially

items.question: How does one become a sky-goer through the one-syllable mantra?
items.inference: The verse states that accomplishment by this one-syllable mantra makes one a sky-goer instantly.
uncertainties: khecara may denote a specific accomplished aerial being rather than generic sky-goer
siddho may refer to an already accomplished practitioner
items.plain_english: By this one-syllable mantra, the accomplished one becomes a sky-goer instantly.
